metadata.dataset: TravelCare AI v2 researched-mock Singapore inventory (hotels + activities around Marina Bay Sands)

queries.query: hotels near Marina Bay Sands Singapore
budget hotels Singapore Clarke Quay prices per night
Marina Bay Sands nearby attractions walking distance
USD to SGD exchange rate today
queries.note: enrichment query: KAYAK prices were observed in USD; Xe mid-market rate 1 USD = 1.27 SGD (S$1.2713) used for approximate conversion, source https://www.xe.com/currencyconverter/convert/?Amount=1&From=USD&To=SGD

research_log: 2026-08-26 TripAdvisor hotels-near-MBS page returned HTTP 403 on fetch; its search snippet still supplied hotel name candidates (The Fullerton Hotel Singapore, The Fullerton Bay Hotel Singapore, PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay) which were then re-verified with prices/distances on the KAYAK MBS landmark page.
2026-08-26 Agoda Singapore country page fetch returned empty content; Agoda search-snippet averages (USD 150 avg 4-star, USD 335 avg 5-star) were NOT used for any entry.

2026-08-26 Star ratings: only Marina Bay Sands stars=5 is directly sourced (marinabaysands.com official title 'Iconic Luxury 5-star Hotel'). All other star ratings were omitted because observed pages only gave review scores, not official star classes. KAYAK category buckets ('2 stars and below', '4 stars and above') were recorded in notes but not converted to numeric stars.

2026-08-26 Prices: KAYAK figures are 'from' prices for Sep 2-9 observed in USD and converted to SGD at 1.27 (Xe, 2026-08-26). Where only one price point was observed, price_range_sgd has min=max. Only Marina Bay Sands has a real range ($786 and $1047+ both observed). Free attractions carry [0,0] because their sources state 'FREE' or 'no admission charge'. Activity ticket prices were omitted entirely because no observed page stated them.

2026-08-26 Distances: hotel distances were observed on KAYAK in miles from Marina Bay Sands and converted to km (x1.609), rounded to 0.1. Budget hotels listed only in KAYAK popularity tables (Wink @ Mosque Street, Hotel 81 Chinatown, Butternut Tree Hotel, Swissotel The Stamford) and all activities carry rough geographic estimates, labeled approximate by the field name.

2026-08-26 Dropped candidates (lacking observed sources): The Fullerton Bay Hotel Singapore, Ascott Raffles Place, Mandarin Oriental Singapore, Royal Plaza On Scotts, YOTEL Singapore, One Farrer Hotel, 21 Carpenter, Hilton Garden Inn details from MakeMyTrip INR prices, Traveloka USD 21.66 Clarke Quay figure (no hotel name attached), HotelsCombined $50/$240 Clarke Quay averages (area-level only), Oxford Hotel and Met A Space Pod (price without verifiable distance), Spectra/SkyPark/Gardens admission prices, Singapore Flyer ticket price, River Cruise ticket price. September pricing context retained in metadata only: KAYAK.sg avg double room S$435/night; TripAdvisor Sep-Nov high-season avg $276 / low-season $207; STB data via Reddit: S$283.47/night in Sep 2022.

september_price_context.qualitative: September is a shoulder month: average rates sit below October Grand Prix peaks, especially midweek and early September (mysingaporestay.com, retrieved 2026-08-26)

metadata.caveats: Researched-mock data. Prices are observed 'from' rates converted approximately to SGD and fluctuate daily; distances are approximations. Live providers plug into the same interface (MASTER_BUILD_PACKAGE.md section 15.2).
